details.s: Sauron (Quenya; or), the eponymous Lord of the Rings, was the greatest fallen Maia, a former renowned disciple of Aulë, the chief agent of the first Dark Lord Morgoth in the Elder Days (First Age), the second Dark Lord, the maker of the One Ring, and self-proclaimed ruler of Middle-earth in the Second Age and near the end of the Third Age.
f: Dark Lord, Lord of the Rings, Lord of the Earth, King of Men, See more
Mairon, Annatar, Gorthaur, the Necromancer, the One Enemy, See more
March 25, TA 3019, Battle of the Morannon Notice: Sauron didn't actually die, he was stripped of physical form
Powers of the Maiar, the One Ring, dark sorcery, mace, sword
Sala Baker, Charlie Vickers, Jack Lowden (prologue)
